newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn approves Germany-Zimbabwe air accord.
newsitem.headline: Bonn approves Germany-Zimbabwe air accord.

text.p: The German government has approved a bill to put a new air accord between Germany and Zimbabwe into German law, the federal transport ministry said in a statement.
The bill will make the accord signed on December 13 on passenger, freight and post air transportation a legally binding bilateral agreement, the statement said.
It replaces an agreement between the countries' civil aviation authorities, it added.
German transport minister Matthias Wissmann said in the statement: "The air accord signifies a further step in the expansion of air travel relations between Germany and the African continent."
Deustche Lufthansa AG currently flies twice weekly between Frankfurt and Harare on a Johannesburg flight and Air Zimbabwe flies twice a week from Harare to Frankfurt.
